text:
Casey (Finance): Heads up: BrightPath disputed INV-2411 (Aug). They say $6,750 in burst charges were caused by our failover and want the disputed amount placed in escrow while we reconcile.

Noah (Billing): Which invoice lines? paste of invoice excerpt: 
```
INV-2411-01,reserved_commit,1,$45,000
INV-2411-02,burst_charges,13500,$6,750
INV-2411-03,taxes,1,$225
```

billing-bot: Dispute DIS-801 opened for INV-2411 on 2026-08-11. Status: awaiting triage.

Rina (Acct Mgmt): BrightPath is pushing for immediate escrow/hold. They refuse partial credit; want cash refund if confirmed. They're an enterprise with CC on file but legal insists on escrow until validation.

Theo (Platform): I looked at scheduler traces for 2026-08-09 22:40 UTC. We had a zone controller handoff that retried jobs and the metrics agent emitted duplicate "active" events. INF-1548 filed. I can export job_id mapping for reconciliation.

Casey (Finance): Policy: we place invoices "on hold" for disputes. Cash refunds > $5k require director sign-off; credits can be issued without exec approval. For escrow, finance can route disputed funds to a holding ledger and pause collection. Approve?

Noah (Billing): Recommend: 1) mark INV-2411 as "on hold - escrow pending"; 2) create provisional escrow ledger entry EQ-207; 3) block collection and notify payments team. Once platform posts deduped job list we'll compute delta.

Rina (Acct Mgmt): I'll message BrightPath: "We've placed INV-2411 on hold and funds in escrow while we validate. We'll follow up with a refund or corrected invoice within 5 business days."

Theo (Platform): Note: not all retries are platform-caused. Reconciliation will be job-level: only events flagged as controller-generated duplicates will be removed. I'll attach deduped CSV to BLG-982 by EOD.

Casey (Finance): Approving escrow ledger EQ-207 for the disputed $6,750 pending reconciliation. Director review required only if we move to cash refund > $5k after validation.

Noah (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-523 as provisional record in case we must apply invoice-level adjustment. Will not post until reconciliation final.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-982: "brightpath-inv2411-escrow-and-dedup" and ledger EQ-207.

Rina (Acct Mgmt): I'll ask BrightPath for their bank details if a cash refund is required and CC legal. Also offering a short incident report and 30-day free burst waiver as goodwill if they prefer credit.

Theo (Platform): Posting deduped job list to BLG-982 now. Preliminary estimate: ~65% of the burst line maps to platform duplicates (~$4,387). Remaining ~35% attributable to legitimate retries.

Casey (Finance): Good. Once you confirm the exact delta I'll prepare either a credit memo for $4,387 or route a cash refund request to directors if BrightPath insists on cash. No collections until final.

Noah (Billing): Will update invoice status to "hold - escrow EQ-207" and await final number. If approved for refund, payments will process; otherwise we'll apply CM-523 and regenerate INV-2411.

Rina (Acct Mgmt): Customer prefers cash refund. I'll notify them of the preliminary figure and that final amount pending validation.

Casey (Finance): Action items: 1) Theo attach final dedupe export to BLG-982 (due 1801239000); 2) Noah create CM-523 and hold collections; 3) Rina coordinate customer comms and bank details if needed. Target resolution within 5 business days.

billing-bot: BLG-982 updated with deduped export (prelim).
